project_type: Next.js 16 App Router + TypeScript + Prisma 7 + PostgreSQL + Tailwind CSS 4
build_system: npm with Next.js build pipeline. Prisma uses pg adapter with PrismaPg. postinstall runs 'prisma generate'.
test_framework: Vitest with tests in src/lib/__tests__/*.test.ts. Tests are unit tests that don't require DB connection.
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npx prisma generate' after schema changes. 2. Run 'npm run build' to verify Next.js compiles. 3. Run 'npm run test' to verify all tests pass. 4. Run 'npm run lint' to check linting.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/generated/prisma/ - generated by 'npx prisma generate' from prisma/schema.prisma. Must regenerate after schema changes.
environment_constraints: No database available for runtime testing - verify via build + type-checking + unit tests only. No Docker daemon available.
contribution_requirements: Never use createMany with PostgreSQL arrays - use individual creates or nested writes. All API routes must have try/catch with error messages. Use extractErrorMessage from src/lib/extract-error-message.ts in client components. ARCHIVED_STATUSES pattern must include 'withdrawn'. Schema version comment must be incremented.
key_patterns: API routes: use formatErrorResponse/validationError/notFoundError from src/lib/api-error.ts. DB access: import { prisma } from '@/lib/db'. Pages: 'use client' with Nav component. Status field on Job is a string with predefined values. Params in App Router are Promise-based ({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }). Client components use extractErrorMessage for error handling. Nav has NAV_LINKS array for navigation.
directory_structure: src/app/ - pages and API routes (App Router). src/app/api/ - API route handlers. src/components/ - React components. src/lib/ - shared utilities and business logic. src/lib/__tests__/ - Vitest unit tests. src/generated/prisma/ - Prisma client output. prisma/ - schema and migrations.
